title: Near miss detection using distancing monitoring and distance-based proximal indicators
abstract: Despite efforts to improve road safety, accidents persist due to insufficient evidence from manual police reporting, non-optimized detection algorithms, and technical limitations in real-time video processing and modelling. This study focuses on detecting and tracking vehicles within a monitoring system and analyzing near-miss incidents (black spot and unseen area), specifically examining the influence of video quality on detection performance using advanced model detectors (YOLOv4-tiny, YOLOv5, YOLOv7, and YOLOv7+ CNeB).
